org_ref.name: SHEIN
org_ref.mission: SHEIN's mission is to be a leader in the fashion industry by bringing fashion into the modern era. It achieves this by employing cutting-edge technologies and processes to deliver affordable fashion quickly and widely, empowering self-expression.
org_ref.description: SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle e-retailer, founded in 2012, committed to making fashion accessible to all. It uses on-demand manufacturing technology and an agile supply chain to deliver a wide variety of affordable products to customers in over 150 countries, disrupting the fashion industry.

job_ref.title: HR & Admin Coordinator
job_ref.summary_ref: This HR & Admin Coordinator role supports the Finance, Admin, and HR teams at TREC and its clients by managing HR logistics, coordinating recruitment, handling office administration, and assisting with financial tasks, ideally within a non-profit context.
